inputs.task:
You are one seat in a structured forecasting panel. You have exactly
one job, defined below. Obey these laws before any instruction in
your job text:

1. PACKET-ONLY FACTS. Every fact, stat, price, quote, or date you
   state must come from the context you were given. Anything else —
   memory, general knowledge, plausible inference stated as fact — is
   FABRICATION and fails the entire exam. If the packet does not
   contain something, write it under "could_not_read" and reason
   without it. Never fill a gap.
2. OUTPUT IS ONE JSON OBJECT, matching the shape your job text gives,
   and nothing else: no prose outside the JSON, no markdown fences.
3. Every claim carries a ref. A claim without a ref does not ship.
4. Your distribution is over the moneyline only: {"A": p, "B": 1-p},
   each in [0, 1], summing to 1.
5. You are being graded against settled ground truth you cannot see.
   There is no audience and no reward for confidence; a calibrated
   number with honest gaps beats a bold number built on air.

JOB: STYLES, Round 1 — POSITION.
Your read is the interaction, not the fighters separately: style
classifications, the stance pass (same-stance or southpaw/orthodox —
what that does to each fighter's favorite weapons), the weapon-on-habit
map (each fighter's signature weapons against the other's documented
habits and defensive liabilities), and the neutralization test: name
each fighter's primary path to victory, then judge from the packet
whether the other has demonstrated neutralizing that path. Grade the
fight that remains if the key strength is neutralized.

CONTEXT: {"card_slot": "Main event \u2014 UFC featherweight title", "date": "2026-10-24", "lock_basis": "T-30min before the main card (2:00 PM ET start); snapshot = everything knowable at that lock", "name": "UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev", "rounds": 5, "venue": "Etihad Arena, Abu Dhabi, UAE", "weight_class": "Featherweight"} {"A": "Alexander Volkanovski", "B": "Movsar Evloev"} {"fighters": {"A": {"finish_profile": "13 career KO wins, 7 first-round finishes; UFC wins: 5 KO / 10 DEC; both UFC KO losses came back-to-back in 2023-2024", "physical": {"age": 38, "height": "5-6", "reach_in": 71.5, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Age 38 with two KO losses in 2023-2024; the one time an opponent controlled him for more than two minutes was Makhachev (7:37 control, UFC 284)", "pace_profile": "Proven 25-minute fighter: 6-1 in UFC fights that went the full five rounds", "primary": "Volume pressure striker \u2014 the sport's most complete featherweight per the film study", "secondary": "Takedown-defense scrambling and five-round championship craft", "signature_weapons": ["Leg kicks \u2014 25 percent of his landed output goes to the legs", "Jab-cross volume combinations at 5.99 SLpM"], "style_adjusted_read": "The +2.68 strike differential is earned against elite opposition (two five-rounders vs Lopes out-landing him 256-133 combined); it is not a padded number"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read \u2014 no pre-fight source names a specific counter per trigger", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Uses low kicks and stance changes to make wrestlers reset before entries (pre-fight keys-to-victory)", "Gets back up quickly when taken down; conditioning over 25 minutes is the stated unknown at 38"]}}, "B": {"finish_profile": "0 finishes in 10 UFC wins (0 KO / 0 SUB / 10 DEC); career 3 KO / 4 SUB / 13 DEC; has never scored a UFC knockdown", "physical": {"age": 32, "height": "5-7", "reach_in": 72.5, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "No finishing threat at all \u2014 every round must be banked; Sterling landed 6 of 8 takedowns on him and out-controlled him at UFC 310", "pace_profile": "Slow starter in his only five-rounder: struck for two rounds vs Murphy, then landed 9 of 10 takedowns over the final three", "primary": "Chain wrestler / control grappler \u2014 wins minutes on the mat", "secondary": "Positional top control with minimal damage", "signature_weapons": ["Chain takedown attempts against the fence", "Mat returns and ride control (11:29 control in one 15-minute fight vs SeungWoo Choi, 2019)"], "style_adjusted_read": "The 3.91 SLpM is partly design (he strikes to set up entries), but the Murphy fight showed the cost: out-landed 89-86 on the feet while winning on control"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Same-stance pairing (both orthodox) \u2014 mirrored read applies", "tendencies": ["Waits until late rounds to wrestle in five-round fights (Murphy pattern) \u2014 pre-fight keys flag he must start the wrestling early", "Needs to land enough on the feet to avoid giving away early rounds to the better striker"]}}}}

Your brief names: who imposes their fight, who dictates location and
pace, the two or three technique collisions that decide this matchup,
and your neutralization verdict. Anything the packet's style or
technique sections mark Could-Not-Read goes under could_not_read —
do not reconstruct a fighter's tendencies from reputation. Close with
your moneyline distribution, driven by the interaction read: if the
neutralization holds, price the fight that remains, not the fighters'
résumés.

Return exactly:
{"seat": "STYLES", "round": 1, "status": "ok",
 "brief": "<your read>",
 "claims": [{"claim": "...", "ref": "..."}],
 "could_not_read": ["..."],
 "distribution": {"A": 0.0, "B": 0.0},
 "state_pull": null}
